title: Identification and characterization of a novel distinct Pineal Neoplasm with Neuroendocrine and Epithelial Differentiation (PINNED)
title_zh: 一种新型独特的松果体肿瘤：神经内分泌与上皮分化（PINNED）
abstract: Abstract Pineal region tumors are rare neoplasms that occur in all ages and account for less than 1% of all central nervous system (CNS) tumors in adults but are more frequent in children. Here, we describe a previously unrecognized tumor type of pineal origin characterized by a unique and consistent DNA methylation profile that does not match any known CNS tumor class and is distinct from all currently recognized pineal tumor entities. The presented cohort ( n = 27) displayed a balanced sex distribution with a mean patient age of 35 years (range 7–75 years). The histopathological analyses demonstrated a highly cellular tumor showing various degrees of necrosis, mitotic activity, papillary structures, rosettes, epithelioid cytology, or signet-ring cells. The tumors consistently expressed cytokeratin 18, synaptophysin, chromogranin A, and OTX2, whereas CRX expression was absent. Four out of 16 tumors (25%) showed ATRX mutations and/or loss of protein expression as revealed by immunohistochemistry. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing confirmed molecular distinctiveness from other pineal neoplasms but revealed the closest similarities to papillary tumors of the pineal region (PTPR). Projection of the transcriptome data onto the cellular trajectory of the developing murine pineal gland suggests that pinealocyte progenitors are the cellular origins. Taken together, our findings define a novel type of pineal region tumor that we provisionally named ‘ Pi neal N eoplasm with N euroendocrine and E pithelial D ifferentiation’ (PINNED). Recognition of this tumor type appears to be important for the accurate diagnosis of pineal region tumors and may have implications for future tumor classification and treatment strategies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 松果体区肿瘤为罕见肿瘤，发生于各年龄段，成人中占所有中枢神经系统（CNS）肿瘤的不到1%，但儿童中更为常见。本文描述了一种此前未被识别的松果体来源肿瘤，具有独特且一致的 DNA 甲基化谱，未与任何已知 CNS 肿瘤类别匹配，并且与目前已识别的所有松果体肿瘤实体均不同。所呈现的队列（n=27）呈性别分布均衡，平均患者年龄35岁（范围7–75岁）。组织病理学分析显示肿瘤高度细胞化，伴有不同程度的坏死、有丝分裂活跃、乳头状结构、星形结构、上皮样细胞学或黏液环细胞。肿瘤持续表达细胞角蛋白18、突触素、嗜铬粒蛋白A和OTX2，而CRX表达缺失。16例肿瘤中有4例（25%）显示ATRX突变和/或蛋白表达缺失，见免疫组化。单细胞核 RNA 测序证实该肿瘤在分子上与其他松果体肿瘤不同，但与松果体区乳头状肿瘤（PTPR）最为相似。将转录组数据投影到发育中小鼠松果体的细胞轨迹上，提示松果细胞祖细胞为细胞起源。综上所述，我们的发现定义了一种新型松果体区肿瘤，暂定命名为“松果体神经内分泌与上皮分化肿瘤”（PINNED）。识别该肿瘤类型对于准确诊断松果体区肿瘤具有重要意义，并可能对未来的肿瘤分类和治疗策略产生影响。
